content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London’s O2 arena ignited a blaze that consumed a van and caused damage to a car and a lorry. Firefighters were dispatched to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before eight o’clock on Saturday evening. After roughly an hour, the flames were brought under control with the help of about two dozen crew members, and no injuries were reported. Authorities said the fire originated from a pre‑planned filming activity taking place close to the venue, which is scheduled to host performances by Niall Horan and Texas in the coming days. The London Fire Brigade updated on X, stating that the fire in Silvertown is now contained, one vehicle was destroyed while most of a car and a lorry suffered damage, and there are currently no injury reports. They added that the incident began with a controlled explosion on the set that spread beyond expectations, prompting rapid firefighting efforts; crews will stay on site for the rest of the evening. The yard is also situated near the Thames cable car link. A Metropolitan Police spokesman noted that they are aware of reports of explosions heard in the area around the O2 in Greenwich.
